evidence.note: Instance-dependent Early Stopping (IES) individualizes training-time early stopping per training instance rather than uniformly, using the second-order difference of an instance's loss trajectory (rather than raw loss) to detect when it is 'mastered' and exclude it from further backpropagation, reducing backpropagation compute by 10-50% while preserving or slightly improving test accuracy and transfer learning.
evidence.title: Instance-dependent Early Stopping
